title: Sava Keruya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.45b.5), a certain old man of Kruya—and some say Sruya—asked Rabbi Yohanan. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Shabbat.45b.5.3) explains Sruya/Kruya as designations after their places.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Here ע״ש means “named after,” because it is followed by “their places.” Kruya and Sruya are the source’s two forms.
The linked Rashi says the designation refers to the man’s place. The text gives alternate forms Kruya and Sruya.
